description: SC-003: given the skill catalogue of the example agent plus the four ranch skills, the model loads the right skill for a message (expect = skill name) and loads nothing for messages no skill covers (expect = null). Needs LLM_API_KEY; skipped as pending without it.

skills.name: ranch
skills.description: Operate the ranch platform through its API: agents (list, create, restart, delete, pods and their state, logs, usage and spend, admin rights, the files of an agent such as SOUL.md), templates and their files, the platform skill catalogue (import from GitHub), knowledge bases (attach, query, sources, freshness), LLM credentials, users and settings.

skills.name: ranch-sessions
skills.description: Third-party services connected or linked to a ranch agent (Instagram, X/Twitter, Google): list the connected sessions and accounts, request or renew a login, disconnect a service, read session secrets and cookie profiles.

skills.name: runtime-tools
skills.description: What the agent itself can do and which built-in tool does it: shell commands and background processes, HTTP and fetching URLs, web search, browser and screenshots, PDF and image analysis, unzip, voice messages, scheduling, memory and secrets. Consult for any question about the agent's own tools or capabilities, or before invoking an unknown command name.

skills.name: skill-creator
skills.description: Create, validate, fix and manage agent skills: write a new skill, turn a procedure into a reusable skill, SKILL.md frontmatter and description rules, size limits, directory layout (scripts, references).

skills.name: github
skills.description: Work with GitHub repositories: open, review and merge pull requests, issues and labels, releases and tags, release notes, commit and file history.
